Implements CT-24t per D10-316 / 335 / 337 / 339 / 341 / 342: list (content.article or notify.channels, no step-up), push / SMS switches, SMS registration saved as a pending test registration with a synchronous test send to the operator's verify phone (accepted / failed 50301 / 50401 / not_sent_no_verify_phone), retest (only 10003 verify_phone_missing), enable gated on the accepted test, discard (no step-up); fund-term codes also need content.fund_terms; SMS variables per real variant; preview checks (variables, SMS_CODE minutes incl. Chinese numerals, BR-TEXT-12 / 13 via content exports); every write is one conditional row_version update (20902 without data, an in-flight test send never overwrites a rival write); audit rows. No money, no attribution, no migration.
